notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch) used throughout; site was fully reachable, no CDN/bot block encountered, so Playwright/CDP and Claude-in-Chrome were never needed. robots.txt has a generic 'Allow: /' for User-agent: * (a few disallows for search/wishlist/dispatcher query params and some crawlers like Yandex/MJ12bot/Bytespider/AhrefsBot are blocked, but no Claude-specific disallow). Checked: (1) homepage full mega-menu HTML, which enumerates the entire site taxonomy as ~150 category links (cat_id 1-679+) spanning Lighting (Ceiling, Wall, Floor & Table, Recessed, Track & Rail, Chandeliers & Pendants, Outdoor, Bath, Kable/Monorail/Strip), Fans, Bulbs, Lighting Accessories, Commercial Lighting, Furniture (Seating, Tables, Rugs, Outdoor Furniture, Office Furniture, Storage, Decorative Mirrors), and Home Décor -- no Christmas, Holiday, Halloween, Diwali, Easter, Valentine's, Thanksgiving, New Year, Mother's Day, or Father's Day category anywhere in this list, and specifically no 'Christmas Lighting' / 'Holiday Lighting' / 'String Lights' category despite this being a lighting retailer. (2) Drilled into the Home Décor node (cat_id=491, breadcrumb Category Home > Furniture > Home Décor) which is the most gift/decor-adjacent branch: its only children are Wall Decor, Planters & Vases, Clocks & Watches, and Decorative Accents (cat_id=647) -- checked Decorative Accents directly (a leaf PLP with a handful of products per filter group) and found no holiday-named products or subcategories. (3) Checked Outdoor Lighting Accessories (cat_id=68) and other outdoor pages for hidden Christmas/string-light subcategories -- none found. (4) Checked the footer (Support, Design Services, About, social, legal links) for any seasonal/gift-guide links -- none. (5) Full-text keyword scan (christmas, holiday, halloween, diwali, easter, valentine, thanksgiving, new year, mother's/father's day, festival, seasonal) across homepage and multiple category pages: the only hits were generic boilerplate unrelated to a product category -- 'Discover exceptional lighting at seasonal savings' (a storewide sale banner, not a holiday category per the sale-page exclusion rule) and 'Special Holiday Hours' (showroom operating-hours notice, not a PLP). (6) Attempted the site's internal search (module=search) using both the 'keyword' and the schema.org-declared 'search' query params for chandelier/christmas/holiday/halloween/string lights/mother's day/father's day/etc. -- the server returns an identical static shell (search is client-side JS/AJAX-driven via a #ss_results autocomplete widget) so HTTP-tier search results were inconclusive and were NOT used as proof of absence; the conclusion rests entirely on the exhaustive nav/taxonomy and page-content checks in (1)-(5), consistent with the rule that a zero-result search alone is not proof of absence. Lightology is a high-end architectural/designer lighting retailer (chandeliers, pendants, recessed, track, landscape lighting) with no consumer seasonal-decor or holiday-lighting line. Conclusion: no genuine seasonal/holiday category exists anywhere on this site.
